caption: The drawing depicts a handheld tool consisting of two main components: a handle and a rectangular stone roller. The handle appears to be made of wood, colored brown with slight variations in shade, and has rounded edges with a central thickened grip section that slightly tapers towards both ends. Metal arms, bent at right angles, extend downward from each side of the handle to support the roller, connecting to the rectangular stone below. The roller is gray, speckled with various shades, and has a rough texture, characteristic of stone. At one end of the stone roller, there is a visible metal screw or bolt, which secures the end of the handle's arm to the roller. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and there is a small, neatly written inscription in the bottom right corner with the name "Lionel Ritchey" and the location "K.C. MO."
title: Knife Sharpener
